question: Which goddess and seed syllables protect the face for all accomplishment?
premises: The syllables aiṃ, klīṃ, sauḥ are invoked
Goddess Bālā is invoked for protection
Protection is sought on the face for all accomplishment
inference: Bālā with the syllables aiṃ, klīṃ, sauḥ protects the face for all accomplishment
plain_english: May aiṃ, klīṃ, sauḥ and Bālā protect me on the face for the accomplishment of all things.
